title: LADY LARISA - Sanlorenzo SX88
highlights: Lithium batteries: 24 h silent at anchor
description:
Delivered new in 2018 and offered VAT paid, LADY LARISA is a Sanlorenzo SX88 crossover maintained in impeccable condition by her original and sole owner. She is one of few yachts her size with a main-deck master stateroom, plus a second full-beam VIP below.

With only 830 engine hours and eight upgraded lithium batteries, she can run all systems for up to 24 hours without generator. Her 7.2-metre beam and shallow 1.7-metre draft make her ideal for Mediterranean cruising.
